北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京体感-12℃，风大天阴，注意保暖防寒哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing feels like -12°C, cloudy with strong winds. Stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪大雾湿冷，体感仅 1℃，出门注意安全和保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy and damp, feels like 1°C. Stay safe and warm!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海大雾弥漫，体感 1℃，出门注意交通安全，添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is foggy and chilly, feels like 1°C. Drive safe and dress warmly.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好 25℃，天气舒适，享受美好时光吧！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and a pleasant 25°C. Enjoy the lovely day!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 22℃，体感舒适。记得多喝水，保持好心情。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and a comfy 22°C. Stay hydrated and cheerful!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州有阵雨，体感 1℃ 且风大，出行记得带伞多穿衣。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has showers, feels like 1°C with wind. Take an umbrella and dress warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京雨夹雪，体感-6℃，注意防寒防滑，多穿保暖衣物。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing has sleet, feels like -6°C. Keep warm, watch out for slips.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 2℃，略有凉意，记得穿件外套哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, feels like 2°C, a bit cool. Remember your jacket!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴冷，体感-6℃。风大湿重，务必穿暖，小心感冒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and very cold, feels like -6°C. Dress warmly to avoid colds.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天湿冷，体感-4℃，记得多喝热水，注意保暖。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and damp cold, feels like -4°C. Stay warm and hydrated.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有阵雨，体感 7℃，湿润。出门带伞，注意防潮哦。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing has showers, feels like 7°C and humid. Bring an umbrella!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨体感-28℃，极寒！务必厚实保暖，小心冻伤。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin feels like -28°C, extremely cold. Bundle up to prevent frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -28℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳虽晴朗，但体感-24℃，出门一定要穿得暖暖的。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels like -24°C. Dress very warmly when going out.
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃ | 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明晴朗温暖 21℃，风力不小，多喝水，享受阳光。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is sunny and warm at 21°C with some wind. Stay hydrated and enjoy!

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴朗 19℃，风力 4级。海边风大，注意防风保暖。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is sunny 19°C with strong winds. Beware of strong coastal winds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴冷，体感-12℃，风力 4级。务必注意防风保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and cold, feels like -12°C with strong wind. Dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴冷，体感-19℃，风力 4级。穿厚衣，小心着凉！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and very cold, feels like -19°C with strong wind. Dress very warmly!
大连.alert: ❄️ 橙色寒冷提示：体感低至 -19℃ | 💨 北风警报：北风 4级
